name: shape-2026-09-26
fit: move/shape time model (research/2026-09-26_shape): stage-1 move costs fitted on 4,904 clean chunks of drawn routes between reliably timed planned clicks over 11 vaults; stage-2 per miner: seconds = moveScale x moves + roomEntryS + roomExitS, fitted on whole plan epochs. Runs scale with vRef / movement speed. Clearance is the planner's own (grid clearanceFlyAt). LOVO room R2 chain 0.60 / vein 0.71; chart-style cpm error with coverage 2.7 % / 2.1 %.
